verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing provides transaction rules to automatically approve/decline authorizations based on business logic, webhooks for real-time events (authorization, configuration), and dynamic spending limits/merchant category restrictions/approval workflows — matching event-triggered automation rules. Missing for 10: no evidence of a broader general-purpose rules engine (e.g., custom multi-condition triggers beyond authorization/spend limits), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of rule reliability at scale.
